label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common), late in the episode (trial >= 75), previous trial rewarded
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2) steps, and only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 (a common transition); it never fires on D1/GO, on S2, or on a2/rare trials. It is also strictly a late-episode feature: there are no activations before episode trial ~65, and almost all fall on trials 75-99, so it seems to track elapsed time within the episode in the recurrent state. Requiring that the previous trial was rewarded raises precision. All conditions are observed at D2 (action and state are shown there), so no future variables are used. Without the late-episode condition, recall of a1->S1 at D2 is 99.7% but precision is only 9%. Even with every condition, precision is only about 0.5: many late a1->S1c D2 steps stay silent. In the examples, magnitude grows over runs of consecutive a1->S1c trials and is lower after an unrewarded or rare trial. Activations are concentrated where S1 is good and the model value is low (<7.1), and are absent when value is >7.5. Dev F1 0.63, mass recall 0.90.
